name: Fabric Materialized Lake Views - Multi Workspace/Lakehouse execution support
description: Multi Lakehouse support in Lineage enables users to visualize and manage dependencies of Materialized Lake Views (MLVs) across multiple workspaces and lakehouses, providing a unified view that helps prevent data silos and improves transparency. It is designed to support scalable lineage tracking, advanced search, and focused navigation, making it easier for data teams to trace upstream and downstream dependencies.
